content.short: Intersend provides an onchain gateway to explore, launch, and pay.
content.description: Intersend is an all-in-one platform that delivers a seamless experience across Web2 and Web3. Via the Explore marketplace, users can connect with peer-to-peer networks, discover decentralized apps, and subscribe to a range of services. SmartProfiles let users link accounts, create profiles, and automate tasks across apps, while StablePay enables automated smart payments with token conversions into stablecoins for lower fees and faster transactions. This toolkit supports streamlined cross-app workflows for individuals and teams alike.
content.meta: Intersend is an all-in-one platform for a seamless Web2 and Web3 experience. Discover Intersend and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
